text:
anya: Quick sync request — we need to lock down the metric naming, tag set, and rollup behavior for per-model/per-route SLO dashboards (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec). Runtime + infra + console all need to agree on ingest shape and cardinality limits before we start building panels.

matt: +1. proposal: base metric names: `runtime.latency_ms`, `runtime.ttft_ms`, `runtime.tokens_per_sec`. Tags: `model`, `route`, `env`, `deploy_tier`, `quantization`. Keep names stable.

kevin: Concern: `route` cardinality. Some customers create thousands of routes or include user IDs. We should define canonical `route_id` (short) + `route_prefix` for rollups. Also cap unique `route` tags emitted per org to avoid high-cardinality.

linda: For SLOs we need accurate percentiles. Runtime should emit histogram buckets (t-digest or HDR) per worker + counts so the aggregator can compute P50/P95/P99. We shouldn't try to compute percentiles at ingest if it loses fidelity.

jo (console-ux): UX needs: default dashboard should show model-level rollup, then a route dropdown (with search). Drilldown to individual route panels. Panels should be able to switch between percentile and histogram view. Also need a compact tokens/sec sparkline in the route list.

matt: Agree on histograms. Suggest metric names for hist: `runtime.latency_hist` (hdr encoded) + `runtime.latency_count` and `runtime.latency_sum` for sanity. TTFT same pattern. Aggregator will produce P50/P95/P99 from hist.

anya: We also need to define sampling and retention. Proposal: emit full histograms at worker level but only keep raw per-route histograms for `top-N` routes by traffic, and roll others into `route_prefix` buckets. That reduces storage.

kevin: Implementation detail: router will annotate each request with `route_namespace` and `route_short` (hash). Emit both tags. Then ingestion can choose to rollup on `route_namespace` for low-volume routes.

console-ux: For panels, we expect the aggregator to provide pre-computed P50/P95/P99 timeseries so the console doesn't have to compute percentiles on the fly. API contract: endpoints `/metrics/slo/{org}/{model}?route=...&quant=...&range=...` returning timeseries for p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec.

linda: On alerting: define SLOs as rolling windows (30d) and burn-rate alerts at route-level and model-level. Base SLI on P95 latency and tokens/sec throughput. We need consistent name mapping between alerting rules and dashboard metrics.

anya: We need concrete metric/tag contract. Draft:
```
metric: runtime.latency_ms
kind: histogram (hdr/t-digest)
tags: model, route_short, route_namespace, env, deploy_tier, quantization, instance_id
additional: emit count and sum: runtime.latency_count, runtime.latency_sum
```

matt: +1 on those fields. For tokens/sec, emit `runtime.tokens_sec` as gauge at worker level tagged by model/route_short and also `runtime.tokens_sec_agg` from aggregator for dashboard.

kevin: Important: normalize `model` values to canonical model ids used in the catalog (no freeform strings). We'll need a mapping service in runtime.

anya: Ownership proposals: eng-runtime implements emitters (PR telemetry/emitters#452), eng-platform implements aggregator rollups & retention config (PR infra/aggregator#198), console implements API and panels (PR console/dashboards#77). Linda -> SRE will own SLO configs and alert rules.

console-ux: UX note: default time resolution for SLO charts should be 1m for last 6h, 5m up to 30d. Also add quick toggles for percentile vs histogram.

linda: Sampling rules: for noisy routes we should sample at 1% but still produce correct overall percentiles by weighting counts. Aggregator must support weighted histograms.

anya: Action items + deadlines:
- eng-runtime (matt + kevin): implement tags + histogram emitters, add route_short and route_namespace by EOD Tue (owner PR: telemetry/emitters#452).
- eng-platform (anya): implement rollup policy and precomputed percentiles API, set default retention/rollup rules by Fri (PR: infra/aggregator#198).
- console (jo): prototype panel wireframes and API contract by Thu (PR: console/dashboards#77).
- SRE (linda): draft SLO definitions and example alert rules for P95/Tokens/sec by Fri.

kevin: note: we also need limits: max distinct `route_short` tags per org = 5000 by default; if exceeded, aggregator returns 429 until cleaned up. Is that acceptable?

linda: 5000 seems ok as a default but add org-level quota override path for enterprise. Document in telemetry policy.

sre-bot: ingest-config-check: metric name `runtime.latency_ms` ok, warns: high-cardinality tag `instance_id` requires sampling or cardinality cap. Recommend removing `instance_id` from dashboard cardinality tags (keep for debug traces only).

anya: Good catch. We'll limit `instance_id` to debug spans and not include in dashboard time-series tags.

matt: I'll open the emitter PR with example instrumentation snippet:
```python
# runtime emitter example
emitter.emit_histogram("runtime.latency_ms", value_ms, tags={
  "model": "gpt-4o-v1",
  "route_short": "r_5f2b",
  "route_namespace": "/chat",
  "env": "prod",
  "deploy_tier": "dedicated",
  "quantization": "4bit"
})
```

jo: Sounds good. Once we have the API contract for precomputed percentiles we'll mock the console panels and iterate.

anya: Final: let's reconvene Tue after emitter PR lands. If anyone hits blockers earlier, ping this thread. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: action-tracker: created ticket INFRA-1209 for aggregator rollup config and TELEMETRY-334 for emitter changes.
